raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 4996 rows but only 4975 distinct txn_id values, and the IDs form a dense range (900001 to 904975, exactly 4975 values), so the 21 extra rows are re-delivered copies, not new transactions. The silver step has no deduplication, so POSTED copies of the same txn_id pass through and inflate the gold aggregates. Keeping one POSTED row per txn_id (earliest ingest) restores uniqueness, assuming the copies are identical, which the shown evidence does not directly confirm.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
